pregame.pressurePoint: Boise State run game vs Fresno State run defense. Boise State is No. 16 of 138 in rush success rate (52%). Fresno State ranks No. 101 against the run (44%). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Expect Boise State to lean on the run early and often, and to keep leaning. Once Fresno State loads the box, play-action is the second punch. Watch Boise State's rushing attempts by halftime. North of 20 means the plan is working.

edges.why: Boise State is No. 26 of 138 against the run (33%). Fresno State ranks No. 134 in rush success rate (34%). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Boise State erases the run. Fresno State gets pushed into passing downs, and that is where this defense makes its money.

Boise State is No. 27 of 138 at the line of scrimmage (2.47). Fresno State ranks No. 130 in line yards per carry (2.56). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Boise State wins first contact. Backs get met in the backfield; screens and the quick game are the counter.

Boise State is No. 16 of 138 in rush success rate (52%). Fresno State ranks No. 101 against the run (44%). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Expect Boise State to lean on the run early and often, and to keep leaning. Once Fresno State loads the box, play-action is the second punch.

Fresno State is No. 54 of 138 in pass explosiveness (1.61). Boise State ranks No. 137 at limiting explosive passes (2.02). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Boise State does not keep the lid on. Fresno State will take shots, and the market total may be underpriced if they land.
